info.title: Memsystems API
info.description:
Memsystems is a single-user study workspace. A Notebook owns Sources, Chat, and Study Materials.

Sources are text, URLs, or files ingested into a Notebook. Chat answers with Citations to the Evidence retrieved from those Sources. Study Material Generation streams a new Study Material from a Brief and the selected Sources.

Agent access uses a bearer Agent Key. The `agentKey` security scheme documents that header; endpoints that accept it are added by the Agent Access feature.

agentKey.description: Agent Key created in Settings. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <agentKey>`.

GroundingMode.description: How tightly the AI must stay grounded in the notebook sources: strict, moderate, or free.

AgentAccessLevel.description: Whether an agent may use a Notebook: on, read_only, or off. null inherits the workspace default.

description.description: Optional short description of the notebook.

folderId.description: Library folder that should contain the notebook.

agentAccess.description: Agent access override for this Notebook. null inherits the workspace default.

description.description: New description, or null to clear it.

icon.description: New icon identifier, or null to clear it.

folderId.description: Library folder to move the notebook into, or null for the root.

agentAccess.description: Agent access override for this Notebook, or null to inherit the workspace default.

bannerFocalPoint.description: Focal point of the notebook banner, or null to reset it.

parentId.description: Parent library folder, or null for the library root.
New parent library folder, or null for the library root.

rawText.description: Plain text content to ingest as a source.

url.description: URL or provider identifier of the source to ingest.

oauthToken.description: Optional OAuth token for providers that require one.

captionText.description: Optional caption or transcript text supplied by the client.

captionFormat.description: Format of the supplied caption text.

folderId.description: Source folder to move the source into, or null for the root.

speakerMap.description: Map of raw speaker labels to display names.

transcriptText.description: Transcript text to attach to the source as a new source version.

query.description: Web Search query used to discover candidate sources.

description.description: Candidate description from the web search result.

candidates.description: Web Search candidates to import as sources.

query.description: Original Web Search query, recorded with the import.

parentId.description: Parent source folder, or null for the notebook root.
New parent source folder, or null for the notebook root.

filename.description: Original filename of the file to upload.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file to upload.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum of the file, as 64 hex characters.

title.description: Optional title for the resulting source.

messages.description: Chat messages for the turn, oldest first.

model.description: Model identifier selected for the Chat.

message.description: Optional message being sent in this request.

regenerateMessageId.description: Assistant message to regenerate, when retrying a reply.

language.description: Base Language code used for the reply.

StudyMaterialKind.description: The kind of study material: quiz, simple flashcard, roadmap, mind map, or slides.

folderId.description: Study Material Folder that should contain the material.
Study Material Folder to move the material into, or null for the notebook root.

name.description: Name of the study material folder.

parentId.description: New parent study material folder, or null for the notebook root.

brief.description: Brief with the instructions and options for the Generation.

sourceIds.description: Sources selected as Evidence for the Generation.

folderId.description: Study Material Folder that should contain the result.

model.description: Model identifier; defaults to the model chosen for the Kind.

questionCount.description: Requested number of quiz questions or flashcards.

difficulty.description: Requested difficulty for quiz or flashcard Generation.

language.description: Base Language code used for the material.

AgentSoftDeletePolicy.description: Whether agents may soft-delete Study Materials: ask for approval or allow it.

AgentConfirmPolicy.description: Whether an agent may perform a destructive action: never, or ask for approval.

GenerationPartialFrame.description: A partial Study Material content object. Fields appear as the model produces them, so any subset of the kind-specific content shape may be present and strings may be incomplete. The frame is a partial of the quiz, flashcard, roadmap, mind map, or slides content shape selected by `kind`.

generalKnowledgeSupplement.description: Present only for moderate grounding; context that goes beyond the sources.

GenerationDoneFrame.description: Terminal frame. The Study Material has been persisted and the Generation is complete.

requestId.description: Generation Request id, also sent as X-Generation-Request-Id.

materialId.description: Id of the created Study Material.

GenerationErrorFrame.description: Terminal frame written after the stream has started. The client should surface `error` and stop reading.

requestId.description: Generation Request id, when one was created.

GenerationFailureResponse.description: JSON error returned before any NDJSON frame was written (for example when the selected Sources are unavailable).

GenerationStreamFrame.description: One NDJSON line from `POST /api/notebooks/{id}/generate`. Lines are emitted as partial Study Material content, followed by exactly one terminal `done` or `error` frame.

ChatCitationCheck.description: Summary of Citation verification for the completed reply.

resolved.description: Number of Citation keys that matched Evidence.

attributed.description: Number of claims linked by Nearest-Evidence Attribution.

dropped.description: Number of unresolvable Citation keys that were dropped.

ChatCitedSource.description: One Source passage cited by the assistant reply.

citationKey.description: Citation key used in the reply text, such as R1.

quote.description: Supporting Span quoted from the Source Chunk.

attribution.description: Whether the Citation was written by the model or linked by Nearest-Evidence Attribution.

ChatMessageMetadata.description: Metadata attached to the `start`/`finish` frames and persisted with the assistant message. Citation fields are populated on `finish`.

ChatUiStreamStartStepFrame.description: Marks the start of one model step.

ChatUiStreamTextDeltaFrame.description: Incremental assistant text. Citations appear inline as `[ref:R1]` markers.

ChatUiStreamFinishStepFrame.description: Marks the end of one model step.

ChatUiStreamFinishFrame.description: Terminal frame. `messageMetadata.citedSources` lists the Citations for this reply.

ChatUiStreamAbortFrame.description: The reply was aborted, for example because the client disconnected.

ChatUiStreamErrorFrame.description: A client-safe error. The stream may continue after this frame.

ChatUiStreamMessageMetadataFrame.description: Replaces or attaches metadata to the current assistant message.

ChatUiStreamSourceUrlFrame.description: A URL Source referenced by the reply.

ChatUiStreamSourceDocumentFrame.description: A document Source referenced by the reply.

ChatUiStreamFrame.description: One server-sent event. Each `data:` line contains one of the listed frames; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. Consumers normally pass the stream to the AI SDK client, which assembles the frames into an assistant message.
